title: Astoria Dispensary | The Bridge
description: The Bridge Cannabis Experience at 25-15 Broadway in Astoria, Queens: a partnership between Havoc of Mobb Deep and NDICA. Hours, directions, online ordering and what is inside.
lede: One shop, one address: 25-15 Broadway. A partnership between Havoc of Mobb Deep and NDICA, and a space as much as a storefront.

sections.heading: Who we are
sections.html:
The Bridge is a partnership between Havoc of Mobb Deep and NDICA. Havoc grew up in Queensbridge and helped define the sound of New York hip-hop. NDICA is a nonprofit working for a cannabis industry that serves the communities hit hardest by the War on Drugs. Put those together and you get a dispensary rooted in culture and built for the community.

Read the whole story.

sections.heading: What's inside
sections.html: The shelves cover flower, pre-rolls, vapes, edibles, concentrates, beverages, wellness and lifestyle, from glassware to merch. What's on the menu changes, so the online store is the place to see it.

sections.heading: More than a counter
sections.html:
We open the floor. Recently at The Bridge: brand pop-ups, a meet and greet with Havoc and a free all-levels mat Pilates class. Brands, artists, wellness practitioners and community groups from the neighborhood can bring us an idea too.

See what's on at Events, or get on The List.

sections.heading: Order online
sections.html: Not coming through today? Order online at store.thebridgecannabis.com. We deliver. Have your ID ready when it arrives: New York requires a check at delivery.

sections.heading: Before you come through
sections.html: It's 21 and over, with a valid ID. First time? The Dispensary Guide covers the whole visit, including how to check any shop on the state's list, ours included. Questions? Get in touch or call 917-832-7420.

faq.q: What do I need to bring?
faq.a: A valid ID showing you're 21 or older. Our Dispensary Guide lists what the state accepts.
